active_chapter.goal: Discover Memorielle / Memory in Every Seed. Life Remembers
active_chapter.lore: In this story, every living seed carries the whole divine nature, still unrecognized. Life did not lack divinity; it lacked awareness of its depth.
active_chapter.title: 58 / Memorielle awakens

active_chapter.goal: Discover Praeselia / Presence Without Distance. Divine Recognition
active_chapter.lore: Before the journey between two places, the same living presence is already at both ends.
active_chapter.title: 63 / Praeselia awakens

active_chapter.goal: Discover Aurethia / Wings of the First Welcome. Dimensional Life: Angels
active_chapter.lore: Beyond recognized divinity, new peoples seek a home. Angelic life awakens as luminous winged beings, each free to choose a calling rather than obey a predetermined virtue.
active_chapter.title: 74 / Aurethia awakens

active_chapter.lore: Build a dimension that lets possible worlds become actual. Reality rests on many interwoven dimensions; later foundations can support earlier creations.
active_chapter.title: 57 / Build Reality Dimension

active_chapter.goal: Build Omnielle / Omniverse Confluence Dimension. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
active_chapter.lore: Omnielle builds a confluence of infinitely many superposed universes. No shared clock, common distance, or single causal law governs their meeting. She shelters their relationships without collapsing their differences; every living world retains its own story.
active_chapter.title: 52 / Build Omniverse Confluence Dimension

active_chapter.goal: Build Seravelle / Angel Realm. Dimensional Life: Angels
active_chapter.lore: Build the Angel Realm, a living dimension of luminous cities and open sanctuaries. Its people sustain their own seasons, friendships, and disagreements; radiance does not make them infallible.
active_chapter.title: 76 / Build Angel Realm

active_chapter.goal: Build Velkaria / Demon Realm. Dimensional Life: Demons
active_chapter.lore: Build the Demon Realm, where obsidian gardens and ember rivers sustain passionate, self-governing peoples. Strength protects the freedom to change, including the freedom to lay power down.
active_chapter.title: 79 / Build Demon Realm

active_chapter.goal: Build Sylphariel / Elves and Fairies Realm. Dimensional Life: Elves and Fairies
active_chapter.lore: Build the Elves and Fairies Realm: a dimension of world-tree cities, petal villages, and rivers of renewing magic. Its many courts preserve wild places and welcome lives unlike their own.
active_chapter.title: 82 / Build Elves and Fairies Realm

active_chapter.goal: Build Asteratheia / Gods Realm. Dimensional Life: Gods
active_chapter.lore: Build the Gods Realm, a dimension of starborne halls and gardens of living archetypes. Its gods tend connections among worlds without claiming ownership of the lives within them.
active_chapter.title: 85 / Build Gods Realm

active_chapter.goal: Build Noctheria / Shadow Realm. Dimensional Life: Shadows
active_chapter.lore: Build the Shadow Realm, where velvet forests and dusk seas nurture life beyond the glare. Its borders offer refuge and chosen passage, never compulsory forgetting.
active_chapter.title: 88 / Build Shadow Realm

active_chapter.goal: Build Concordielle / Concord of Living Realms Dimension. Concord of Living Realms
active_chapter.lore: Build a dimension of relationship among the Angel, Demon, Elves and Fairies, Gods, and Shadow realms. Their homes remain sovereign and alive: unity protects difference rather than erasing it.
active_chapter.title: 91 / Build Concord of Living Realms Dimension

active_chapter.goal: Discover Gaudielle / Joy: Creation in Bloom. Universal Emotions
active_chapter.lore: Across every realm, joy welcomes another beginning. In this myth, blooming gardens and gathering stars echo life's delight; no one must feel happy to deserve belonging. Claim this chapter to unlock Happy.
active_chapter.title: 92 / Gaudielle awakens

active_chapter.goal: Discover Terranielle / Human Life on Earth. Human Life and Soul Resonance
active_chapter.lore: On planet Earth, humans live through bodies, families, communities, and changing seasons. This fictional saga imagines that a soul might also reside in another realm at the same time; earthly life remains fully real and worthy of care.
active_chapter.title: 102 / Terranielle awakens

active_chapter.goal: Build Concordanima / Embodied Soul Dimension. Human Life and Soul Resonance
active_chapter.lore: Build a dimension that holds Earthly embodiment and possible soul-presences in other realms together. Its bridges represent coexistence rather than escape or compulsory travel. Different beliefs are welcome: no human must claim a soul-home to have a place in creation.
active_chapter.title: 107 / Build Embodied Soul Dimension
